resolution.label: 1080p HD visible sensor + 640x512 15µm cooled MWIR thermal

sensor: Cooled MWIR thermal detector (XBn, 20mK NETD, 30Hz, 15µm, 640x512) + 1/1.9" CMOS 2.38MP HD visible sensor

lens.aperture: Thermal F4.0; Visible F3.5-F16 (to F32 with x2 extender)

field_of_view_deg: Thermal 12.6-0.7 (H); Visible 21.2-0.45 (H, to 0.23 with x2 extender)
operating_temp_c: -32 to 65 (-40 with optional Cold Weather Pack)
dimensions_mm: PTU H434 x W275 x D336mm (excl. mounts/through shaft/payload); thermal housing L1000 x W319 x H292mm; visible housing L900 x W290 x H246mm
features: 18x motorised thermal zoom, 60x motorised HD visible zoom (120x with x2 extender)
Thermal human detection range up to 24.3km (NVIPM, 50% probability)
Optical image stabilisation on HD visible sensor (cost option)
NexOS core: push/continuous autofocus, automatic ROI, digital zoom, CLAHE, de-fog, 2D image stabilisation, static overlays, remote upgrades/diagnostics
NexOS Performance Pack (cost option): 3D image stabilisation, target tracking, target classification, event detection, dynamic overlays, dynamic boresight, edge recording
Through shaft for fixed payload (e.g. RADAR) mounting above PTU
Rapid-release anodised aluminium boresight bracket with micro-adjustment
Pelco D and ONVIF Profile-S control
Nitrogen-purged sensor housings, marine-grade paint finish
